can: Consigo falar de arte e cultura, usar orações relativas mais complexas e recomendar e comentar uma obra.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Arts and creativity (exhibition, gallery, masterpiece, portrait, sculpture, audience, review, plot, genre, soundtrack, critic, gripping).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: We went to an exhibition of modern art.
The film is a true masterpiece.
He painted a portrait of his mother.
The sculpture is made of bronze.
The critics gave the play great reviews.
The plot is predictable but fun.
What's your favourite genre of music?
The film didn't live up to the hype.

items: **a gripping story**, **a moving performance**, **a thought-provoking film**
**stage / put on** a play; **direct** a film; **star in** a film
**leave a lasting impression**; **be well worth seeing**
"The film is very exciting" não descreve quem sente: **I was excited** (pessoa) x **The film is exciting** (coisa).
"I assisted the play." **Assist** é ajudar. Para assistir a uma peça: **I saw / went to the play.**
"The actuation was great." Em inglês: **The acting was great** ou **performance.**
"The pictures of the exposition." **Exposition** é explicação; exposição de arte é **exhibition.**

exercises.prompt: The film is a true ___. Everyone should see it.
The ___ stood and applauded for five minutes.
The film didn't live up to the ___.
The ___ is predictable, but the acting is excellent.
I assisted the play last night.
acc: I saw the play last night
I went to the play last night
I watched the play last night

exercises.prompt: The actuation was great.
We went to an exposition of modern art.
acc: We went to an exhibition of modern art

chat.role: Amigo curioso que quer decidir se vai ver também.
chat.goal: Usar 6 palavras da aula, com plot, acting, exhibition e gripping corretos.

en.vocab: Arts and creativity (exhibition, gallery, masterpiece, portrait, audience, review, plot, genre, soundtrack, critic, gripping). Key terms: the acting, an exhibition, live up to the hype, gripping.

lessons.title: Orações relativas avançadas
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: relativas não restritivas, preposição + whom/which, which para a frase inteira e orações reduzidas.

head: Tipo
Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: My brother, who lives in Rio, is an artist.
The woman to whom I spoke was the curator.
The woman I spoke to was the curator.
The play was sold out, which surprised everyone.
The man standing near the door is the director.
The paintings displayed here are by local artists.
Whoever wins will get the prize.

items: **Com vírgulas** a informação é extra. **Sem vírgulas** ela identifica a pessoa ou coisa: *Students who study hard pass* (só os que estudam) x *The students, who study hard, passed* (todos).
Em relativa não restritiva **não se usa that**.
Não repita o pronome: *the film that I saw* (não *that I saw it*).
"The film that I told you about it was great." O certo é **The film that I told you about was great.**
"My brother, that lives in Rio, is an artist." O certo é **My brother, who lives in Rio, is an artist.**
"The girl which I met is a painter." Para pessoas: **who / that**: **The girl who I met...**
"The play was sold out, what surprised everyone." O certo é **, which surprised everyone.**

exercises.prompt: My brother, ___ lives in Rio, is an artist.
The woman to ___ I spoke was the curator.
The play was sold out, ___ surprised everyone.
The man ___ (stand) near the door is the director.
The film that I told you about it was great.
acc: The film that I told you about was great
The film I told you about was great

exercises.prompt: My brother, that lives in Rio, is an artist.
acc: My brother, who lives in Rio, is an artist

exercises.prompt: The play was sold out, what surprised everyone.
acc: The play was sold out, which surprised everyone

chat.scenario: Você descreve à IA artistas, filmes e livros de que gosta, usando frases com informação extra.
chat.role: Amigo que pede detalhes sobre as pessoas e as obras citadas.
chat.goal: Usar 2 relativas não restritivas com vírgulas, 1 com which para a frase inteira, 1 com preposição + whom ou which e 1 reduzida.

en.gram: Advanced relative clauses: non-defining, preposition + whom/which, which for a whole clause, reduced relatives
en.vocab: Arts and creativity (exhibition, gallery, masterpiece, plot, audience, critic). Key terms: who, which, whose, to whom, standing, displayed.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, recomendar e comentar uma obra
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Recomendar e comentar uma obra.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: I'd highly recommend it. / It's well worth seeing. / You have to see it.
It's about a young woman who... / I won't give anything away.
The acting was outstanding. / It's beautifully shot. / The plot kept me hooked.
It's a bit slow in the middle. / It didn't quite live up to the hype.
It reminded me of... / It's similar to..., but more...
It left a lasting impression on me.

items: "I recommend you to see it." O certo é **I recommend seeing it** ou **I recommend that you see it.**
"The film is spoiling the end." Para estragar a surpresa: **spoiler**. **I won't spoil it for you.**
"It's a film very good." O adjetivo vem antes: **It's a very good film.**

exercises.prompt: It's well ___ seeing.
I won't give anything ___.
The plot kept me ___ from beginning to end.
It didn't quite live ___ to the hype.
I recommend you to see it.
acc: I recommend that you see it

exercises.prompt: It's a film very good.
acc: it is a very good film
it has a very good film
It is a very good film

exercises.prompt: Escreva 3 frases recomendando um filme ou série sem contar o final.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.

chat.scenario: Um amigo pede uma recomendação de filme ou livro para o fim de semana e você comenta o que viu.
chat.role: Amigo indeciso que faz perguntas e pergunta o que você não gostou.
chat.goal: Recomendar uma obra, resumir o enredo sem dar spoiler, elogiar 2 pontos e fazer 1 crítica com tato.

en.vocab: Arts and creativity (plot, acting, soundtrack, gripping, masterpiece, review). Key terms: I'd highly recommend, well worth seeing, it kept me hooked, lasting impression.
